_doc: Tool model of Microsoft Paint (Windows 11). alpha = fraction of the stroke colour laid on white in one pass (measured live: black stroke on white). opacity_setting = the Opacity slider applies to this tool (pencil and brush only). Re-measure with `cli.py calib-plan` / `calib-measure` and save a copy as tools.json next to ui.json. coverage = mean share of alpha a stroke actually lays (ramped / streaky tools); the planner uses alpha x coverage to pick colours.

watercolour.fitted: 2026-10-24: calibration stroke (core 0.70, two passes 0.89, 12 px area-width at size 16) + fit to the live watercolour and sumi-e Mona Lisa crops (wet-edge ramp over 80 % of the width, hair streaks); live_vs_sim on those plans 14.8 -> 10.8 and 12.1 -> 8.0

fill.note: Paint's Fill (bucket): one click floods the connected area of exactly the clicked colour. connectivity = what the simulator floods with (4, most likely for Paint); fill_conn = what plans are made safe for ('both' until speed-calib measures it, then 4 or 8).

_doc_speed: speed (px/s), stepPx and strokeGapMs per tool override the emitter defaults (8000, the tool stepPx, 2 ms); null = default. speed-calib / speed-measure find the fastest setting with no missing pixels.
